description: This file defines the Currency PHP class used in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM for handling currency data, conversions, and formatting functions. It includes methods for converting currencies, retrieving default configurations, and generating HTML dropdowns for currency selection.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Encapsulates handling of currency conversions, retrievals, and display formatting within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: convertToDollar
methods.description: Converts a given currency amount to USD based on the connection rate.

methods.name: convertFromDollar
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to the target currency using the conversion rate.

methods.name: getDefaultCurrencyName
methods.description: Returns the default currency name from system configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Returns the default currency symbol from system configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultISO4217
methods.description: Returns the default ISO 4217 currency code.

methods.name: retrieveIDBySymbol
methods.description: Retrieves the currency ID for a given symbol if it exists and is not deleted.

methods.name: retrieve_id_by_name
methods.description: Fetches the currency ID by its name.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Loads currency data into the object; if ID is -99, loads default currency.

methods.name: getPdfCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Returns the currency symbol for PDF rendering, with special handling for the euro symbol.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares currency data for list view display, formatting the conversion rate.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the currency object and clears cache.
